title: What your dog's head tilt means
topic: Why do dogs tilt their heads?

lines: Your dog's head tilt might mean it actually understands you.

beats.label: dogs asked for toys by name
lines: In 2021, researchers in Budapest watched forty dogs as their owners asked for toys by name.

beats.title: Asked for a toy by name...
lines: Most dogs rarely tilted their heads.
But seven dogs that knew the names of many toys tilted again and again.
The tilt came when they heard a word that meant something.
Researchers think it's linked to processing meaningful sounds.

beats.title: And each dog's tilt...
lines: And each dog tilted to the same side for two years.
So next time your dog tilts its head, say its favorite toy's name.
You might be watching it think.

sources.claim: 2021 Animal Cognition study, 40 dogs, gifted word learners tilted more when asked for named toys; same side over 24 months

youtube.title: What your dog's head tilt really means 🐶
youtube.description: A 2021 study found dogs that know toy names tilt their heads far more. Here's what scientists think it means.
